messages:
Marco (Support): Heads-up — multiple customers flagged billing spikes for Feb 24th usage. Dashboards show clear ingestion gap 03:20–03:45 UTC and then a big replay/backfill spike. Can infra confirm what happened?

Ella (Customer Success): +1 from enterprise CX — they saw a ~3x token count on their invoice draft. They're holding payment questions until we reconcile.

Jonas (Billing): I can freeze invoices but need a root cause and a corrected token count. Which pipeline emitted the late events?

Mei (Eng-SRE): Initial look: metering-collector consumer lagged, then we saw a sudden surge when the replay kicked in. Consumer group offset gap ~1.2M messages.

Priya (Eng-Platform): I checked deploys — no deploys in that window. There was a retention purge on the kinesis staging stream at 03:18 that may have caused connector retries.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Kafka metrics: broker-2 IO spikes around 03:16, then controller flapped for ~90s. Could be transient. Consumer got OffsetOutOfRange when it tried to resume, fallback triggered replay tooling.

infra-bot: backfill-job-789 status: FAILED (exit code 2); reason: Missing partition metadata.

Mei (Eng-SRE): The backfill tool failed during partition discovery; it retried but produced duplicate event batches when the connector resumed, which doubled tokens for some customers.

Marco (Support): Ack. We need concrete repro steps and a mitigation plan. Customers asking for corrected counts.

Priya (Eng-Platform): Action plan: 1) Re-run backfill in dry-run mode to compute delta per-customer. 2) Run dedupe pass using event ids (we have idempotency key). 3) Produce corrected token ledger and hand to Billing. Who can run the dry-run?

Mei (Eng-SRE): I can run dry-run on staging cluster now. Command I will use:
```
replay-tool --source=kinesis-staging --target=metering-db --start=2026-02-24T03:00:00Z --end=2026-02-24T04:00:00Z --dry-run --output=./dryrun-1768001123.json
```
Expect ~30m for a 1.2M message window.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): I'll check broker logs and surface any RAID or disk warnings. Also increasing consumer concurrency might avoid future backlog.

Jonas (Billing): Please include per-tenant token deltas in the dry-run output. I'll need CSV with columns: tenant_id, original_count, replay_count, deduped_count.

Ella (Customer Success): I'll message affected accounts with a short note: "We detected a metering ingestion and backfill anomaly; our team is running a reconciliation and will share corrected usage within 48h."

Mei (Eng-SRE): Dry-run complete. Output stats: total_events_seen: 1,240,187; duplicate_candidates: 184,309 (15%). Sample of dup keys: 
```
["evt_9843a","evt_9f23b","evt_a22c9",...]
```
Location: s3://redwood-backfill/dryrun-1768001123.json

infra-bot: backfill-dryrun-1768001123 uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-backfill/dryrun-1768001123.json)

Priya (Eng-Platform): Good. Next step: run dedupe pass with idempotency filter and write to a staging ledger. Command: 
```
replay-tool --dedupe --id-key=event_id --input=s3://redwood-backfill/dryrun-1768001123.json --output=staging-ledger-1768001123.csv
```
Estimated 15m.

Mei (Eng-SRE): Deduped output produced. Per-tenant summary attached in S3: s3://redwood-backfill/staging-ledger-1768001123.csv

Jonas (Billing): Downloading and reconciling now. Preliminary: total token delta across tenants: -2.1M tokens (i.e., earlier invoices overstated by ~2.1M tokens). I'll prepare credit memos and updated invoices.

Marco (Support): Are there any tenants with >25% delta? We should prioritize outreach.

Jonas (Billing): Affected list: tenant_332 (30% delta), tenant_119 (28%), tenant_901 (5% but high $ impact). I'll mark tenant_332 and tenant_119 as P1 for manual review.

Ella (Customer Success): I'll loop CX for tenant_332 & tenant_119 and set expectations.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Root cause summary draft: controller instability caused partition metadata to be temporarily unavailable; replay tool retried without fresh metadata causing overlapping batches. Mitigations proposed: 1) Hard fail replay when partition list mismatch, 2) Add additional idempotency checks on ingestion, 3) Alert on consumer offset gaps > 100k.

Priya (Eng-Platform): Agree. Also will add a pre-replay dry-run check to compute potential duplicates estimate before committing writes.

Mei (Eng-SRE): I'll open a postmortem with timeline, logs, and the exact command outputs. Draft ETA: 24h.

infra-bot: backfill-job-789 rerun in dedupe mode: SUCCEEDED (duration 00:14:22)

Marco (Support): Great. Jonas, once billing posts credits, please ping here and I will update customers.

Jonas (Billing): Credits issued for tenant_332 and tenant_119; tenant_901 will get a partial credit pending manual review. I posted CSV of adjustments to the billing drive.

Ella (Customer Success): Sent update to affected customers with the credit breakdown and links. Responses so far: tenant_332 appreciative; tenant_119 wants a postmortem.

Mei (Eng-SRE): Postmortem draft uploaded: https://redwood.docs/postmortems/metering-backfill-1768001123 (contains timeline, mitigations, and follow-ups).

Priya (Eng-Platform): Follow-ups assigned: Add pre-replay check (Priya), tighten replay idempotency (Mei), alert threshold for offset gap (Ravi). Due EOD next week.

Marco (Support): Closing loop: customers informed, billing credits sent, infra mitigations planned. Marking incident as resolved for customer-facing channel. Will keep internal follow-ups open. :white_check_mark:

Ella (Customer Success): Thanks team! :pray:

Mei (Eng-SRE): +1, will update postmortem after final review.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): I'll monitor broker metrics for 72h and post any anomalies.

infra-bot: Incident 1768001123 status: RESOLVED.
